scope: Chrome on Windows; imported GFL2 Ilion movie via the common MovieStreams player
checks: One HTML media element with picture and selected audio SourceBuffers
Paused/playing language switches preserve time, rate and volume
Reload retains selected language and saved movie position
Real audio decoding observed after switching
Random forward/backward seek reaches buffered media; buffered intersection remains below 50 seconds
Selected-language installation excludes other audio and combined MP4 compatibility files
Missing offline language keeps installed current track and explains missing download
Adding another language reuses picture/cache objects; downloaded movie seeks offline

accounting.note: These are distinct URL inventories in current descriptors. Combined fallbacks are retained physically; shared-stream delivery savings do not mean those files were reclaimed.

limits: Other browsers and devices were not exercised
No combined fallback exports were deleted
Browser heap measurements were not used as a whole-library memory guarantee
